content: {"episode_id":"ep-05014","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), for which prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias; the claim diagnosis codes are I48.0 and I49.9. The mobile cardiac telemetry study was ordered to accurately capture the frequency and duration of these symptomatic events for appropriate management."}
